title: She built India's first tissue culture lab. Then, after retiring, she trained rural women as health workers.

sources.text: The News Minute - Cancer research pioneer Dr. Kamal Ranadive honoured with Google Doodle on 104th birth anniversary
Deccan Herald - Google Doodle celebrates cancer research pioneer Kamal Ranadive's birthday

caption:
She built India's first tissue culture lab. Then, after retiring, she trained rural women as health workers.

A cell biologist, she founded India's first tissue culture research laboratory at the Indian Cancer Research Centre in Mumbai in the 1960s and was among the first to propose links between heredity and breast cancer.

A career that started in a cancer research lab ended by putting basic healthcare knowledge directly into the hands of rural women - work recognized with a Padma Bhushan.

Ranadive's career is a reminder that scientific achievement and rural upliftment aren't separate goals - the same person built both.
